contexts.text: The external of the Church is signified by the signet, the pannicle, and the staff ()... The pannicle = external truth.

Thy pannicle () = through truth; namely, a token of consent... The reason a pannicle = truth, is that it is among the things which relate to garments... But the pannicle = outermost or lowest truth: it was made of threads twisted together, by which are signified the determinations of such truth. A pannicle = such truth also in, Every open vessel, upon which there is not a pannicle for a covering, it is unclean (), by which was signified that nothing should be indeterminate; for that which is indeterminate is open. It is also the outermost truths to which the interior truths are determined, and in which they are terminated.
Boys tie a handkerchief over their eyes...
Like those who cover their eyes with a handkerchief.

Therefore the Lord compares the truths of the former Church... to a piece of cloth from an old garment; and the truths of the new Church, which were spiritual truths themselves, to a piece of cloth from a new garment.
